intent: Add the token_audit package so per-session Claude token spend can be parsed from transcripts, attributed to a cause (skill, hook, rule file, image), and reported.
scope: python_pkg/token_audit/ — new package (parse, model, attribute, imagecost, report, __main__)
python_pkg/token_audit/tests/ — 81 tests covering all seven modules
Non-goal: no changes to existing python_pkg packages or the pre-commit config
Non-goal: poker-stakes/ and its README row are another session's work, deliberately left uncommitted
changes: parse.py reads session transcript JSONL into typed records; model.py holds the dataclasses
attribute.py assigns token cost to a cause; imagecost.py prices image blocks separately
report.py renders the aggregate; __main__.py exposes the CLI entry point

verification.command: python -m coverage run --branch --source=python_pkg/token_audit -m pytest python_pkg/token_audit/tests/ -q && python -m coverage report
verification.evidence: TOTAL 394 stmts, 0 miss, 100 branch, 0 partial, 100% — all 7 modules at 100%
ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit, codespell, coverage enforcement, requirements-sync and leaked-secrets checks all Passed

risks: Transcript JSONL schema is external and may drift; parse.py would need updating if Claude changes its record format
Image cost constants are point-in-time pricing and go stale when rates change
rollback: git revert the 'Add token_audit package' commit — the package is self-contained and nothing else imports it
After rollback, re-run pytest on python_pkg to confirm the suite is still green
